recommendations.section: ## 1. Current State: A Verified Reliability Audit
recommendations.current: **The backends the fleet never runs.** The audit closes on the three crates no host exercises: backend-kde hard-fails without a session bus (`Connection::session().await?` at `backend-kde/src/lib.rs:41`) and has zero fleet consumers because no jupiterOS host runs Plasma — greps for plasma/kde across hosts and modules return nothing, and the hard-fail is the stated boundary condition for ever hosting a desktop class (it must adopt the generic backend's warn-and-continue degradation first); backend-gamescope's only fleet consumer is callisto's arcade session, with kiosks reaching gamescope via the shared dashboard-gaming modeSpecs; backend-lutris ships behind the `jupiter.gaming.console` appCatalog but no host configuration exercises its launch-only buttons, its JSON field names hedged unverified — lutris among the backends the repo itself flags "Unverified in a live environment" (alongside zfs and syncthing) [[repo-map-ha-linux-agent]].
recommendations.recommended:
**The backends the fleet never runs.** The audit closes on the three crates no host exercises:

- **backend-kde** hard-fails without a session bus (`Connection::session().await?` at `backend-kde/src/lib.rs:41`) and has zero fleet consumers because no jupiterOS host runs Plasma — greps for plasma/kde across hosts and modules return nothing, and the hard-fail is the stated boundary condition for ever hosting a desktop class (it must adopt the generic backend's warn-and-continue degradation first).
- **backend-gamescope**'s only fleet consumer is callisto's arcade session, with kiosks reaching gamescope via the shared dashboard-gaming modeSpecs.
- **backend-lutris** ships behind the `jupiter.gaming.console` appCatalog but no host configuration exercises its launch-only buttons, its JSON field names hedged unverified — lutris among the backends the repo itself flags "Unverified in a live environment" (alongside zfs and syncthing) [[repo-map-ha-linux-agent]].

recommendations.section: ## 6. JupiterOS-Specific Feature Gaps
recommendations.current: Three caveats the hook design carries: device self-test support is optional per drive (an Intel 600p reports "Device Self-test Not Supported" via the oacs bit while still reading healthy), so the inherited scheduling needs a capability check, not an assumption [[how-to-check-nvme-ssd-health-newbie-corner-arch-linux-forums]]; the surface decision — separate entities versus attributes on a disk entity — has an incumbent cautionary precedent in go-hass-agent exposing SMART as attributes that template sensors must individually surface [[how-to-see-your-ssdhdd-health-directly-in-home-assistant-diy-ideas]]; and the bridge should expose wear and vendor product-EOL as distinct sensors, since a drive at ~1 % of rated TBW can already be flagged EOL [[whats-the-best-way-to-monitor-nvme-health-applications-endeavouros]].
recommendations.recommended:
Three caveats the hook design carries:

- **Device self-test support is optional per drive** (an Intel 600p reports "Device Self-test Not Supported" via the oacs bit while still reading healthy), so the inherited scheduling needs a capability check, not an assumption [[how-to-check-nvme-ssd-health-newbie-corner-arch-linux-forums]].
- **The surface decision** — separate entities versus attributes on a disk entity — has an incumbent cautionary precedent in go-hass-agent exposing SMART as attributes that template sensors must individually surface [[how-to-see-your-ssdhdd-health-directly-in-home-assistant-diy-ideas]].
- **The bridge should expose wear and vendor product-EOL as distinct sensors**, since a drive at ~1 % of rated TBW can already be flagged EOL [[whats-the-best-way-to-monitor-nvme-health-applications-endeavouros]].
recommendations.rationale: The three named caveats are already enumerated in prose; bullets make each caveat's consequence and citation scannable in isolation.

recommendations.section: ## 6. JupiterOS-Specific Feature Gaps
recommendations.current: The audited absence first: a search of `modules/` and `hosts/*/` for ups, nut, and apc declarations returns zero matches — no jupiterOS host declares a UPS, so power monitoring maps to no host class in today's fleet. The corpus still fixes the design for the day one is attached, because the HA-native shape is NUT and its ceilings are the agent-side consumer's requirements: the integration cannot talk to a UPS directly (a NUT server is required, port 3493, 60-second default polling), it can retrieve but not set NUT variables and supports no parameterised commands, device actions (instcmds such as beeper.disable, test.battery.start.quick, power-cycle outlet) require credentialled upsd.users grants, it cannot auto-detect a server IP change (DNS-name resolution, never baked IPs). Most diagnostic sensors are disabled by default as a deliberate recorder-cost trim; `upsc`/`upscmd` enumerate the raw surface an agent-side consumer reads directly [[network-ups-tools-nut-home-assistant]]. With switches now restarting user units disruptively, a booted-vs-current-generation sensor converts the new switch behaviour from a surprise into an observable — telling HA which hosts run a stale generation after a switch, cheap to read, fleet-relevant for the first time [[anyone-seeing-nixos-rebuild-switch-kick-you-out-to-gdm-andor-log-gpf-errors-spec]].
recommendations.recommended:
The audited absence first: a search of `modules/` and `hosts/*/` for ups, nut, and apc declarations returns zero matches — no jupiterOS host declares a UPS, so power monitoring maps to no host class in today's fleet. The corpus still fixes the design for the day one is attached, because the HA-native shape is NUT and its ceilings are the agent-side consumer's requirements:

- The integration cannot talk to a UPS directly (a NUT server is required, port 3493, 60-second default polling).
- It can retrieve but not set NUT variables and supports no parameterised commands.
- Device actions (instcmds such as beeper.disable, test.battery.start.quick, power-cycle outlet) require credentialled upsd.users grants.
- It cannot auto-detect a server IP change (DNS-name resolution, never baked IPs).
- Most diagnostic sensors are disabled by default as a deliberate recorder-cost trim; `upsc`/`upscmd` enumerate the raw surface an agent-side consumer reads directly [[network-ups-tools-nut-home-assistant]].

With switches now restarting user units disruptively, a booted-vs-current-generation sensor converts the new switch behaviour from a surprise into an observable — telling HA which hosts run a stale generation after a switch, cheap to read, fleet-relevant for the first time [[anyone-seeing-nixos-rebuild-switch-kick-you-out-to-gdm-andor-log-gpf-errors-spec]].
recommendations.rationale: The five NUT ceilings are a limitation list buried in prose; bullets expose them while the audited-absence opening and the generation-sensor close become their own paragraphs.

recommendations.section: ## 8. Ordered Improvement Roadmap
recommendations.current: Three developments would legitimately reopen settled questions and deserve standing watch: a merged-and-released upstream reconnect signal (which would let the raw ConnAck match become an event variant and trigger the version bump — but would not change the design, since subscriptions stay application-owned); an incumbent shipping native select controls with state sync or a NixOS service module (go-hass-agent's zero-occurrence record through v14.15.1 is the current evidence against) [[changelogmd]]; and an end-to-end MQTT v5 decision, which loosens the clean-session reasoning and makes message expiry the stale-command cure — the v5 module already ships inside the pinned version.
recommendations.recommended:
Three developments would legitimately reopen settled questions and deserve standing watch:

- **A merged-and-released upstream reconnect signal** — which would let the raw ConnAck match become an event variant and trigger the version bump, but would not change the design, since subscriptions stay application-owned.
- **An incumbent shipping native select controls with state sync or a NixOS service module** — go-hass-agent's zero-occurrence record through v14.15.1 is the current evidence against [[changelogmd]].
- **An end-to-end MQTT v5 decision** — which loosens the clean-session reasoning and makes message expiry the stale-command cure; the v5 module already ships inside the pinned version.
recommendations.rationale: The three standing flip conditions are the report's falsifiability contract; bold-labelled bullets make each trigger and its current evidence independently scannable.
